## Purpose

What concrete capability, correction, or proof should exist when this issue is complete?

## Authority boundary

Which repository owns the law involved here? What must this slice explicitly not claim or absorb?

## Dependencies

What already-landed contracts, artifacts, repositories, issues, or pull requests does this slice depend on?

## Acceptance proof

What executable test, fixture, receipt, replay, rendered artifact, or other falsifiable evidence will prove completion?

## Non-goals

What tempting adjacent work is deliberately excluded from this issue?

## Stop condition

What exact condition means this slice is done and should stop expanding?
